audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Vex / Vex / Skill / Skill / Vex / Skill / Skill; content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Diana / Diana / Vex / Vex / Diana / Vex / Vex. All seven rows disagree, and three of them have whys describing Diana winning a stage the row would now award Vex.
audit.why: Diana owns levels 1-2 (900 Q, no fear online often enough) and the level 6 Moonfall window at 100s against a 140s Shadow Surge. Vex owns 3-5 and everything from first item, because Looming Darkness at a flat 12s plus Doom 'n Gloom punish the exact dash Diana's kit is built on.
audit.corrected: Move all seven full-layer sides onto the content values and rewrite the whys on rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 so they describe Vex winning.

audit.why: Diana's spike is the level 3-5 Q-E-Q window and level 6 Moonfall (100s); Vex's are her first item and Shadow Surge at 140s rank 1 with 2000/2500/3000 range. The content spikes already frame it that way once the fabricated names come out.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the fear to Personal Space throughout — focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns and every report line say "Personal Space (Fear)". Personal Space is a shield that damages nearby enemies; the fear is Doom 'n Gloom, the passive. breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit in it.
audit.why: Riot's passive text is decisive here and it is the single most important thing in this matchup: Vex's empowered next basic ability fears and INTERRUPTS DASHES, and whenever a nearby enemy dashes she marks them for bonus damage that reduces her empowered cooldown. Diana's entire pattern is dashing, so every Lunar Rush both risks the interrupt and accelerates the next one.
audit.corrected: Name Doom 'n Gloom as the fear in breakdown.cooldowns, tldr, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.carry and the two moved whys, with Personal Space 16s / Looming Darkness flat 12s / Shadow Surge 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabricated mechanics in the content layer: "Gloomstalker" (no such ability), "Mist stacks" and "Mist damage on Personal Space" (there is no Mist — Gloom comes from Looming Darkness), and Shadow Surge described twice as fearing on landing.
audit.why: Riot's text for Shadow Surge is a marking missile with a recast dash and damage — no fear component. Her passive is Doom 'n Gloom and the Gloom application is Looming Darkness.
audit.corrected: All five strings rewritten with the real names and the real ultimate behaviour.

edits.before: From level 6 onward Vex becomes considerably scarier: Shadow Surge lets her dash directly through you and fear you on arrival, flipping any all-in you attempt into a bad trade for you. Her passive stacks fear faster the more she hits you, so extended poke exchanges start favoring her once she's fed some AP. Bait her ult and dodge the dash before committing Moonfall, or you'll eat a fear into a burst combo instead of landing your own.
edits.after: From level 6 onward Vex becomes considerably scarier: Shadow Surge marks you from up to 3000 range and lets her dash straight onto you, flipping any all-in you attempt into a bad trade for you. Every dash you take marks you for Doom 'n Gloom and shortens her empowered timer, so extended exchanges start favoring her once she's fed some AP. Bait the recast and dodge the dash before committing Moonfall, or you'll eat a fear into a burst combo instead of landing your own.

notes: Chart: all seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and packet.levelChart (which agree with each other). I moved the full layer onto the content values, so there is NO paired win[N] edit — win[N] is already correct on every row and an edit whose before equals its after cannot be written. Rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 had whys describing Diana winning under rows that now read Vex; all four were rewritten in this same proposal. The page-wide convention 'Personal Space (Fear)' is a MISATTRIBUTION baked into focus.text, loading and several report entries: Personal Space is a shield that damages nearby enemies, and the fear plus dash-interrupt is Doom 'n Gloom (P). I corrected it everywhere inside my writable scope; focus.text and loading are short label strings that would read oddly half-changed, so I left them and flag them here — a follow-up pass should retarget focus to 'Vex Doom 'n Gloom'. Fabrications removed: 'Gloomstalker', 'Mist stacks', 'Mist damage on Personal Space', and Shadow Surge fearing on landing (Riot's text gives it a mark and a recast dash, no fear). packet.suspectNames flagged 'Her Shadow Surge' and "Personal Space's" — both FALSE POSITIVES as names; the errors around them were attribution, not spelling. I left diff at TRICKY 7/10: the win rate is 50.88% but the chart is 4-3 to Vex and her kit specifically counters the dash, so the rating is defensible and I would rather not move it without a stronger signal.
